# Dev/lint/test tooling for this repo — hash-pinned so `pip install -r
# requirements-dev.txt` verifies every package (including transitive
# dependencies) against a known-good hash, satisfying OpenSSF Scorecard's
# Pinned-Dependencies check (see .github/workflows/scorecard.yml).
#
# Dependabot bumps versions and regenerates hashes directly in this file —
# no separate .in source file, so there's nothing to keep in sync.
#
# To add/remove/upgrade a direct dependency by hand instead: edit the
# top-level `# via -r requirements-dev.txt`-tagged entries below in a copy
# of this file, then regenerate (requires `pip install pip-tools` first —
# pip-compile refuses to use the same file as both input and output):
#   cp requirements-dev.txt /tmp/requirements-dev.src.txt
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe \
#     --output-file=requirements-dev.txt /tmp/requirements-dev.src.txt
